title: PHILADELPHIA FLYERS AGREE TO TERMS WITH FOUR PLAYERS

body:
The Philadelphia Flyers announced today they have agreed to terms with forwards **Jack Studnicka, Danila Klimovich, Zach Aston-Reese, and defenseman Cam Dineen**, according to General Manager Daniel Briere.

**Studnicka**, 27 (2/18/1999), has agreed to terms on a two-year, two-way contract. The 6-foot-1, 187-pound forward spent the 2025-26 season with the Florida Panthers and their American Hockey League (AHL) affiliate, the Charlotte Checkers, where he appeared in 19 games at the NHL level and 41 games at the AHL level.

Studnicka has spent parts of the last nine seasons splitting time between the NHL and AHL, totaling 16 points (6g-10a) in 126 NHL games and 192 points (69g-123a) in 266 AHL games. Prior to turning professional, the Tecumseh, Ontario native played four seasons of junior hockey with the Oshawa Generals (2025-19) and Niagara IceDogs (2018-19) of the Ontario Hockey League (OHL), where he spent his final two seasons with Oshawa as captain.

**Klimovich**, 23 (1/9/2003), has agreed to terms on a one-year, two-way contract. The 6-foot-2, 203-pound winger has spent the previous five seasons (2021-26) in the AHL with the Abbotsford Canucks, accumulating 70 goals, 53 assists, and 123 points in 281 games.

In 2024-25, the forward set AHL career highs in goals (25) and points (38) and added four goals through 16 postseason games with Abbotsford to help them win Calder Cup Championship. In 2021, the Pinsk, Belarus native represented his country at the IIHF World Championship and IIHF World Under-18 Championship.

**Aston-Reese**, 31 (8/10/1994), has agreed to terms on a two-year contract worth an average annual value (AAV) of $875,000. The forward split the 2025-26 season between the Columbus Blue Jackets and their AHL affiliate, the Cleveland Monsters. Over the last nine seasons since 2017, the 6-foot-1, 203-pound forward has played 416 NHL games with Columbus (2024-26), Detroit (2023-24), Toronto (2022-23), Anaheim (2021-22), and Pittsburgh (2017-22), totaling 102 points (49g-53a).

The Staten Island, New York native has tallied 92 points (40g-52a) through 150 AHL games with Cleveland (2025-26), Grand Rapids (2023-24), and Wilkes-Barre/Scranton (2017-19). Prior to turning professional, Aston-Reese played four seasons of collegiate hockey at Northeastern University (NCAA) from 2013-17.

**Dineen**, 28 (6/19/1998), has agreed to terms on a two-year, two-way contract. The 5-foot-11, 188-pound defenseman spent the 2025-26 season with the Bakersfield Condors in the AHL, recording three goals, 18 assists, and 21 points in 40 games. Over the last eight seasons, Dineen has appeared in 383 AHL games with Bakersfield (2022-26) and Tucson (2018-23), notching 191 points (37g-154a).

The blueliner has suited up in 38 career NHL games with Edmonton (2024-25) and Arizona (2021-22) and has recorded seven assists. Prior to turning professional, the Toms River, New Jersey native played three OHL seasons with Sarnia (2017-18) and North Bay (2015-18).
